components.name: Main button
components.description: The one dark action per screen (Capture on Home).
components.css: .ds-btn-main { height: 34px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #1d1b26; color: #fff; font: 600 14.5px 'Sofia Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .15s ease, transform 80ms ease; } .ds-btn-main:hover { background: #34313f; } .ds-btn-main:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-main:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2b50c4; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outlined button

components.name: Quiet button

components.name: Check cell

components.css: .ds-check { width: 20px; height: 20px; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; padding: 0; border-radius: 6px; border: 1.5px solid #8f8c9c; background: #fff; color: transparent; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .12s, border-color .12s; } .ds-check:hover { border-color: #2b50c4; } .ds-check[aria-checked='true'] { background: #2b50c4; border-color: #2b50c4; color: #fff; } .ds-check:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2b50c4; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Due stamp
components.description: Signature: the next review date pressed into a ticked row; also days left on a goal.
components.css: .ds-stamp { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 3px 6px 2px; border: 1.5px solid currentColor; border-radius: 4px; color: #5b3cc4; font: 700 13px/1 'Sofia Sans Condensed', 'Sofia Sans', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .04em; text-transform: uppercase; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; transform: rotate(-3deg); animation: ds-press 260ms cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.25,1) both; } @keyframes ds-press { from { opacity: .25; transform: scale(1.32) rotate(-9deg); filter: blur(.8px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: rotate(-3deg); filter: none; } }

components.name: Segmented control
components.description: Soft row; the chosen one dark, with its count (All notes: Vault, Scratch, Inbox).
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; height: 34px; padding: 3px; border-radius: 10px; background: #f2f1f5; } .ds-seg button { padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: #4b4858; font: 600 13.5px 'Sofia Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg button:hover { color: #1d1b26; } .ds-seg button[aria-selected='true'] { background: #1d1b26; color: #fff; } .ds-seg span { font-weight: 500; opacity: .8; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview: Today is the slip glued inside a library book: the short list due today, each item stamped with its next date the moment it is done. On an app screen the world lends only a palette (slip white or graphite, slip-blue print, stamp-violet ink), a type voice (Sofia Sans with condensed capitals for stamps), density, and one signature move, the due stamp. Layout, navigation and controls stay standard web parts. Home is short and finite: one hero slip drawn against the daily budget, a light Focus list, tasks only when due, and a compact rail with the goal's honest forecast and a copy-first pocket.
keyCharacteristics: Paper lies flat: hairline rules, no card shadows; only floating layers lift.
One accent for what can be clicked; violet only for stamped dates and marks.
States always speak twice: colour plus an icon and words.
Nothing opens by itself; failed calls stay inside their own section.

rules.name: One accent
rules.body: Slip blue goes only on what can be clicked.

rules.name: Stamp ink is a date
rules.body: Violet appears only where the system stamped a date or a mark.

rules.name: Flat paper
rules.body: Cards carry a hairline, never a shadow; never border + shadow together.

rules.name: Rank by weight first
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from weight before size; nothing under 12 px.

dos: Say the day plainly: "2 to revise · about 16 min · 16 waiting".
Name buttons by what happens and keep the name through confirm and toast.
Let text wrap; rows grow, nothing is cut with an ellipsis.
donts: Open anything by itself on load.
Show red for lateness, a streak flame or a percentage of blocks.
Use eyebrows, coloured left edges, cards inside cards, gradients, glows or a monospace costume.
